'''Imperial Pad 693''' was a landing pad at [[Mondder Spaceport]] on [[Etti IV/Legends|Etti IV]]. It was where [[Jahan Cross]] landed when he visited the [[Corporate Sector/Legends|Corporate Sector]] investigating the [[Iron Eclipse]] project.
